validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + SPEC, verified against TWO independent, non-GEM, live primary sources that are NOT the two footnotes' link text alone but were read in full: (1) an archived CNPC/PipeChina 'Southwest Pipeline Branch Company Oil & Gas Pipeline Network Facilities' table (web.archive.org snapshot of cnpc.com.cn, PDF, first archived 2021 and still resolving at HTTP 200 through 2026) — its natural-gas-pipeline section lists a row '中缅钦州支线' (Sino-Myanmar Qinzhou Branch), route '西二线南宁站-钦州港站' (West-East Gas Pipeline 2 Nanning Station -> Qinzhou Port Station), length 141.2 km, commissioned 2014/7/6, design capacity 14.4 (亿方/年, i.e. 1.44 bcm/y); (2) a 2021-08-29 single-source-procurement notice (广西信永工程咨询有限责任公司, published via 采招网, archived as an image on archive.org, item 2023-09-19-195825, HTTP 200) for a pipe-relocation project on the SAME line — it states verbatim '中缅管道钦州支线起自西二线南宁支干线的南宁末站，止于钦州港广西石化炼厂末站，线路水平长约141.156km，管径D813mm，设计压力10MPa，目前运行压力为6MPa' (length ~141.156 km, diameter D813mm, currently running at 6MPa — i.e. actively conveying gas as of the notice date). Cross-checked against the sheet: LengthKnown=141.00km (matches both 141.2/141.156), Diameter=813mm (matches source 2 exactly — this is NOT a data-entry contamination from the similarly-813mm-diameter Liuzhou-Guilin Branch/P4719 elsewhere in this roster, as I initially suspected when the gem.wiki page itself shows a blank Diameter field; it is independently, separately sourced), Capacity=1.44 bcm/y (matches source 1 exactly, 14.4 亿方/年), StartYear1=2014 (matches source 1's 2014/7/6 commissioning date), Status=operating (source 2's 'currently running at 6MPa' directly confirms active operation; source 1 lists it as an in-service Southwest Pipeline Branch facility), Owner/Operator='National Pipe Network Group Southwest Pipeline Co., Ltd.' (matches source 1's document title/issuing entity, the Southwest Pipeline Branch of PipeChina), and Start/End locations Nanning->Qinzhou (matches both sources' route description, source 2 further specifying the Qinzhou-end terminus as the Guangxi Petrochemical refinery station). CLASSIFICATION: correctly a natural-gas transmission branch (source 1's table section III, 天然气管道) fed off the West-East Gas Pipeline 2 Nanning station, not a gathering/distribution line. DUPLICATE check against the full 43-row Guangxi roster: no match — the other 813mm-diameter rows (P4719 Liuzhou-Guilin Branch, 155.7km/2.5bcm/y; P4694 Guangdong West, 156.12km/4.0bcm/y) are different routes/lengths/capacities, not this pipe. A web search also surfaced an unrelated, much shorter (12km, 4MPa) 'Qinzhou branch' of the China-Myanmar main line serving local town-gas distribution — that is a distinct, smaller facility from this 141km trunk branch and is not in this roster, so no double-count risk there either. Both url_verifier.py runs on these two URLs returned OK/200 (liveness); the automated substring/content screen registered a FAIL on both (expected: PDF binary text extraction and an image-only archive.org page respectively) — per the verifier's own documented false-negative classes, both pages were read in full manually (PDF text extracted via the file-reading tool; the archive.org screenshot viewed as an image) and their content demonstrably supports every value above, so both are cited as verified per-source rather than discarded on the automated screen.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: This is an operating (not in-development) row, but I still hunted for evidence dated newer than the sheet's LastUpdated (2023-09-19). The most specific and most recent direct evidence of the pipeline's operating state is the 2021-08-29 relocation-project procurement notice, which states the line was 'currently running at 6MPa' (i.e. actively conveying gas) at that date — a stronger, more specific confirmation of live operation than a mere commissioning date. Searched further (web search for 中缅钦州支线 / 中缅管道钦州支线 2024/2025) and found only broader China-Myanmar oil-and-gas-pipeline-system coverage (e.g. a December 2024 ESG report on the whole China-Myanmar pipeline project) that is not branch-specific but is consistent with continued, uninterrupted system-wide operation through 2024 — no news of a shutdown, decommissioning, or capacity change for this branch specifically. No dormancy/staleness concern applies (this is a long-operating asset, not a stalled proposed/shelved project awaiting the 2y/4y presumption rules). Confirming Status=operating as-is.

summary: P4487 (Nanning-Qinzhou Branch Pipeline) is real and correctly recorded: two independent, non-GEM, verified-live Chinese sources (an archived CNPC/PipeChina facilities table and a 2021 pipe-relocation procurement notice for the same line) jointly corroborate length (141km), diameter (813mm), capacity (1.44 bcm/y), 2014 start, operating status, owner, and route — including the diameter value, which is NOT contaminated from another roster row as initially suspected.
